title: Execute hybrid lexical retrieval through typed Fourfold relation plans
masterplan_authority: Revision 11 / Version 2.2.0 / Gate 1 — Renovation and owner-directed Genesis

reuse: bounded contraction IR and reference interpreter

finding: The previous Tensor retrieval experiments compared a representation against specialized indices. The retained measurements show that most apparent query gain came from preindexing while a simple relation index remained faster. The untested architecture is to retain lexical retrieval as the physical seed index and use the typed Fourfold algebra as the logical cross-plane query and evidence-composition layer.
primary_claim: A pure, revision-bound compiler now projects authoritative KnowledgeForest edges and verified Fourfold bindings into canonical full-plane TypedRelationBlock objects. A proposal-only hybrid retriever keeps BM25 and exact identifier lookup as the seed/fallback index, executes one declared ContractionPlan under Boolean, Natural and Evidence-DAG observers, requires their typed support to agree, and fuses only graph-supported targets by RRF while retaining path counts and evidence clauses.

design.physical_seed_index: deterministic in-memory BM25 plus exact identifier boost
design.reference_execution: TypedRelationBlock CSR under the existing interpreter
design.fusion: reciprocal-rank fusion of source lexical seeds, target lexical hits and graph support

acceptance: relation axes use complete Fourfold plane memberships so independently compiled relations compose exactly
Forest edges and their matching verified binding projection produce one semantic relation fact rather than duplicate path support
explicit absent relation signatures compile to empty typed blocks instead of missing catalog entries
Boolean, Natural and Evidence-DAG observers return identical source-target support for the same plan
Tropical compilation refuses because ForestEdge.weight has no declared path-cost semantics
BM25 and exact identifier lookup remain callable without graph execution
typed multihop execution filters a lexically relevant but semantically inconsistent source
hybrid hits retain supporting seeds, natural path multiplicity and evidence alternatives
all results remain proposal-only and automatic promotion remains zero
no existing main file, store, registry, scheduler, authority or semantic plane is changed

verification.claim: Only exact-head executed GitHub workflow results count as evidence.

rollback: Revert the single implementation commit. Main-authoritative Forest/Fourfold contracts are untouched and no persisted hybrid state exists.
